sources.title: Jorge Nocedal and Stephen J. Wright, Numerical Optimization, second edition
sources.locator: Complete 683-page second-edition PDF. Relevant material inspected: Chapter 3 §3.2, Theorem 3.2 and Zoutendijk proof (printed pp. 37–40); Chapter 5 §5.1 CG exact minimization and residual orthogonality (printed pp. 102–107); §5.2 FR/PR/PR+ formulas, Lemma 5.6 and Theorem 5.7 with complete proof (printed pp. 121–130).

full_text_read.method: The complete second-edition PDF was opened as a 683-page document and its relevant full-text sections and proofs were inspected through the PDF text view; no abstract or citation-only reasoning was used.
full_text_read.scope: The complete relevant reasoning in §§3.2, 5.1 and 5.2, including the full FR Theorem 5.7 proof, the PR+ discussion, and the exact quadratic/linear-CG relation.

contents.name: §5.2 FR and PR recurrences, PR+ truncation, restart discussion
contents.support: The method formulas are stated locally with the finite-budget search and status branches.

contents.name: §5.2 Lemma 5.6 normalized FR descent recurrence
contents.support: The local lemma proves the normalized slope and adds a direction-growth recurrence needed by the local liminf proof.

contents.name: §3.2 Theorem 3.2 and §5.2 Theorem 5.7, complete FR liminf proof
contents.support: The source gives the independent FR result. Its bounded-level-set assumption is stronger; the local proof derives the stated result without a bounded-level assumption.

contents.name: §5.2 PR+ descent and restart discussion
contents.support: The source's PR+ line-search modification differs from this pair's two-test restart; the local angle proof supplies the exact claim.
contents.reason: The source obtains descent with a modified Wolfe line-search condition, whereas this pair proves its own angle guarantee from the stated norm-and-descent restart tests.

contents.name: §5.2 global PR+ discussion
contents.support: The source's PR+ result is not imported; the local safeguard and the inspected uniform-angle corollary prove this statement.
contents.reason: The book’s PR+ convergence route uses its separate line-search modification; this item proves the distinct local safeguard result through the imported Zoutendijk corollary.

contents.name: §3.5 line-search procedure discussion
contents.support: The finite-budget status and evaluation count are proved from the local algorithm and its bounded search subroutine.
contents.reason: The Wolfe procedure is owned by the required nonconvex-line-search page; this pair uses its actual bounded strong-Wolfe algorithm and proves only the outer-loop finite-budget conclusion.

contents.name: §5.1 and §5.2 exact-quadratic CG relation
contents.support: The book describes the SPD-quadratic exact-line specialization; the item proves the precise FR/raw PR+ equivalence and restart caveat.

full_text_read.method: The complete 22-page PDF from the first author's INRIA publication page was opened and its full-text sections and relevant theorem arguments were inspected.
full_text_read.scope: The relevant full reasoning in §§1–4, including the FR descent/liminf treatment, the distinct bounded-level-set hypotheses, the PR+ formulation, and the exact-quadratic convention.

contents.name: §1 nonlinear recurrence and definition by reduction to linear CG on a strictly convex quadratic
contents.support: This independent article gives the recurrence conventions and exact-quadratic relationship; the full procedure is stated locally.

contents.name: §2 Theorem 2.1 and §3 Lemma 3.1, FR strong-Wolfe descent bounds
contents.support: The article supplies a second treatment of the FR recurrence under strong Wolfe conditions.

contents.name: §2 Theorem 2.1 and §3 Theorem 3.2, complete FR liminf route
contents.support: The source gives an independent liminf result with a bounded-level-set hypothesis; the local proof avoids that extra assumption.

contents.name: §4 nonnegative-PR convergence mechanisms
contents.support: The article's sufficient-descent and Property (A) conditions are different from this local norm-and-angle safeguard.
contents.reason: The article requires its Property (A) and sufficient-descent conditions; the local two-test safeguard has a different interface and receives a direct proof.

contents.name: §4 Theorem 4.3, nonnegative-PR convergence
contents.support: The article's theorem uses bounded level sets and Property (A); no imported theorem supplies the local safeguarded result.
contents.reason: The theorem assumes bounded level sets and Property (A), neither of which is the local safeguard interface; the gradient-norm result is proved from the exact local angle bound.

contents.name: Finite-budget line-search status
contents.support: This result is a direct finite-loop proof for the locally specified algorithm.
contents.reason: The article gives no finite outer/search budget claim; this item derives termination and counts from the explicitly finite local procedures.

contents.name: §1 exact-line quadratic reduction convention
contents.support: The article defines the exact-quadratic reduction property; the complete equality proof is supplied locally.
